cases.input:
Routing Basics & Tables

A router forwards packets between networks.

Concept: Routing Table

Each entry maps a prefix to a next hop. The router picks the longest match. This is called longest prefix match.

Key Idea: the most specific route wins.

How it Works

  • Look up the destination.
  • Pick the longest prefix.
PrefixNext hop
10.0.0.0/8R1

How it Works

show ip route
graph LR; A-->B

Concept: Static vs Dynamic

Static routes are typed by hand; dynamic ones are learned with a routing protocol.

Common Mistake: thinking static routes update themselves.
